page.overview:
What is And I Love Her?

And I Love Her is a ballad sung by Paul McCartney, credited to Lennon/McCartney. It appears on the album A Hard Day's Night (1964) as well as appearing in their hit movie of the same title as the album, A Hard Day's Night (film) (1964).

This song by Paul was one of his beautiful songs. He really liked music in the 1920s and 1930s. Jane Asher felt that Paul never thought her feelings and love were true while the fans were imaginary.
